dedupe_keys.name: development of validated methods for soil structure interaction analysis of buried structures

description: Development of validated methods for soil-structure interaction analysis of buried structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ertugrul Taciroglu, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). The seismic response of underground structures is a complex soil-structure interaction (SSI) problem in which two fundamental mechanisms are at play. Kinematic SSI is concerned with the motion of the structure in the presence of spatially variable ground motions and the interface pressures that develop as a result of different structural and free-field motions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2XW9R. Published 2017-08-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
